digest.component_or_area: ticket planning and lifecycle intent modeling
propositions: Lifecycle decisions (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment-identity) must be modeled as versioned intents only, with intent.version == observation.version exactly

Create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites must be encoded as explicit inter-ticket dependencies in TicketPlan, yielding deferred dispositions with reason dependency_deferred when blocked

Selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limit decisions must be applied during pre-effect planning and recorded with deterministic deferral reasons (scope_deferred, safety_aborted) before any lifecycle intent or remote effect is eligible
Ticket-sourced tombstones, index lag, moved keys, impossible links, and partial snapshots must map to deterministic skipped dispositions
plan_pass must remain pure with zero I/O and support versioned lifecycle intents and pre-effect exclusion with reason tagging
Pure oracle tables must assert exact intent values, dependency edges, and (disposition, defer_reason) pairs, with repository/provider write seams poisoned during planning
